audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored 'Skill' and first item 'Singed', while the prose says level 6 is the moment the lane flips to you and Sunfire only narrows the gap.
audit.why: The packet stage read and the matchup's own mid/whys text both give Sejuani level 6 outright.
audit.corrected: Level 6 set to Sejuani, first item set to Skill; the rest of the chart (Singed 1-4, Singed at two items) is correct for a 45.74% matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phases named Fling, Mega Adhesive and Insanity Potion with no cooldowns.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Mega Adhesive 17/16/15/14/13s, Insanity Potion a flat 100s, Glacial Prison 120s at rank 1. Those numbers turn 'respect Fling' into a countable window.
audit.corrected: Fling written as 10s at rank 1 in the phases, wants and whys; Glacial Prison's 1300 range written into the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and one omission. The text calls Frost Armor 'your Permafrost passive' and says it strips the instant Poison Trail touches you; and Mega Adhesive's grounding is never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Sejuani's passive is Fury of the North and Riot's text says Frost Armor 'persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage' — it does not vanish on contact. Permafrost is the E stun. Meanwhile Mega Adhesive grounds, and Arctic Assault is Sejuani's only dash: standing in the goo she cannot Q in or out, and Fling landing her in the goo also roots. That is the combo that decides the lane and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Fury of the North named as the passive and its persistence stated; Mega Adhesive's grounding written in as the reason never to Q at a goo'd position, with Fling-into-goo as his root setup.

audit.why: Glacial Prison stuns the first champion hit and the storm slows everyone else — there is no root.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as a 1300-range stun on the first champion hit, with the storm slowing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing records that Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: His R is his own anti-heal; your Grasp and Second Wind sustain are cut for its full 100-second cooldown window.
audit.corrected: Flagged in notes rather than edited — no writable field had room without displacing a higher-value correction.

edits.after: Poison Trail chips you for free — take W, last-hit at range, and never contest the wave up close.
edits.before: One of the weakest level 1s in top lane — take W, hit the wave, last-hit, and give absolutely nothing.

edits.after: Fling is live at 2 on 10s — Arctic Assault is your exit, and it is dead the second you stand in his goo.
edits.before: Q online gives you an exit — use it to leave fights, not to start them, until your tank stats exist.

edits.after: Full kit: W-W into E Permafrost is your trade — land it in Fling's downtime, before Poison Trail stacks.
edits.before: Full kit: W-W into E Permafrost is your trade — land it on his step-up and walk before his counter-pattern starts.

edits.after: Frost stacks decide every trade: fight only with the full Q-W-E chain. Fling is 10s at rank 1 — go on its downtime.
edits.before: Frost stacks decide every trade: fight only when the full Q-W-E chain is available. Track Fling before stepping up.

edits.after: Glacial Prison outranges him at 1300 — stun him before Ghost and Insanity Potion turn this into a footrace.
edits.before: Glacial Prison online — every jungle visit is now a guaranteed CC chain. Your lane becomes a gank magnet.

edits.after: Sunfire closes the durability gap — you survive long enough to land Permafrost now.
edits.before: First tank item ends the squishy phase — you stop losing the trades your stun starts.

edits.after: Insanity Potion move speed means you never catch him — only an R on grouped enemies at a pit pays.
edits.before: You're a teamfight engine now — the lane barely matters if your R hits two people at the dragon pit.

edits.after: Poison Trail chips Frost Armor, but it lingers briefly after damage — his real level-1 tool is the goo's grounding.
edits.before: Singed's Poison Trail shreds your Permafrost passive off before you can close, denying every early trade window.

edits.after: Never Q into Mega Adhesive — the goo grounds you, so Arctic Assault is locked and Fling reverses everything
edits.before: Land Arctic Assault BEFORE he can Fling you — if he catches your Q, he reverses the entire trade pattern

edits.after: Stack Frost with both Winter's Wrath arcs and Permafrost him inside Fling's 10-second rank-1 downtime
edits.before: Stack Frost with W's both strikes and E stun him when his Fling is on cooldown, not while he is winding up

edits.after: Fling you into Mega Adhesive so you land rooted and grounded, with no Arctic Assault out
edits.before: Fling you into his Poison Trail and run you down with Ghost and Insanity Potion move speed

edits.after: Poison Trail chips Frost Armor, but Fury of the North persists a short time after damage — level 1 is free chip for him, not a stripped-armour disaster.
edits.before: Singed's Poison Trail strips your Permafrost passive armor the instant it touches you — Level 1 gives him free chip damage you cannot answer without Fling bait.

edits.after: Fling arrives Level 2 on a 10-second cooldown and Mega Adhesive grounds — inside the goo your Arctic Assault is disabled and the flip has no answer at all.
edits.before: His Fling is available Level 2, turning your own Q engage into a death sentence if he catches you mid-dash — never commit Arctic Assault without knowing Fling's cooldown.

edits.after: Glacial Prison stuns the first champion hit at 1300 range before Ghost matters — walk up through the storm and chain both W arcs into Permafrost.
edits.before: Glacial Prison lands before he can react with Fling or Ghost — the blizzard zone roots him long enough to walk up for your full W into E stun chain.

notes: Two real errors: the text called Frost Armor 'your Permafrost passive' (Permafrost is the E stun; the passive is Fury of the North) and claimed it strips the instant Poison Trail touches you, when Riot's text says it persists a short time after damage. The buried interaction is Mega Adhesive: it grounds, and Arctic Assault is Sejuani's only dash, so the goo locks her in place and a Fling into it also roots — none of that appeared anywhere in either layer. NOT EDITED, for the user: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds for its 100-second window, which cuts Grasp and Second Wind sustain; no writable field had room for it without displacing a bigger fix.
